# Sumanta Mukhopadhyay

> Fractional CTO, principal engineer and AI architect based in the United States and the UAE. Ontology and knowledge graphs, production RAG and agentic AI, private LLMs, healthcare data (FHIR, OMOP, HIPAA), scalable data platforms (1M+ transactions/day) and multi-cloud infrastructure.

Contact: sumantamukhopadhyaywork@gmail.com · Book a call: https://calendar.app.google/fpARv4QHsYCLMo3a8

## Services
- [Fractional CTO](https://asksumanta.com/fractional-cto/): Part-time, senior technology leadership. A fractional CTO for strategy, architecture, hiring and board reporting, from first AI product to scale. US & UAE.
- [AI & LLM architecture](https://asksumanta.com/ai-architect/): AI and LLM architecture that ships: production RAG and GraphRAG, LangGraph agents, MCP, LLM evaluation and private on-prem models. Strategy to production.
- [Ontology & knowledge graphs](https://asksumanta.com/ontology-knowledge-graph/): Ontology engineering and knowledge graph consulting: shared business semantics, entity resolution, semantic layers and GraphRAG that make data and AI agree.
- [Healthcare data architecture](https://asksumanta.com/healthcare-data-architecture/): Healthcare data architecture consulting: HL7 FHIR interoperability, OMOP CDM and OHDSI research platforms, HIPAA-aligned cloud and clinical AI with guardrails.
- [Technical due diligence](https://asksumanta.com/technical-due-diligence/): Independent technical and AI due diligence for VC, PE and corporate investors: architecture, code, team, security, scalability and a value-creation plan.
- [Fractional CTO in the UAE](https://asksumanta.com/uae/): Fractional CTO and AI consultant for Dubai, Abu Dhabi and the GCC: AI strategy, data platforms and cloud, built for UAE PDPL, DIFC, ADGM and data residency.

## Insights
- [FOCUS and AI spend: how to make token costs visible to finance](https://asksumanta.com/insights/focus-finops-ai-cost-allocation/): The FinOps FOCUS standard now spans cloud, SaaS and AI. What versions 1.3 and 1.4 cover, where token costs still fall outside it, and how I build AI cost allocation today.
- [TEFCA in 2026: what changed, and what health tech teams should build for](https://asksumanta.com/insights/tefca-2026-what-health-tech-should-build/): TEFCA exchange volume has grown fast and new uses like benefits determination are live. What changed in 2026, the FHIR roadmap, and how health tech products should prepare.
- [Data contracts: a practical playbook for pipelines that stop breaking](https://asksumanta.com/insights/data-contracts-playbook/): Data contracts turn the interface between data producers and consumers into something written down and checked. How I introduce them with ODCS, CI checks and versioning.
- [MCP Apps and tool annotations: how to govern what agents show and do](https://asksumanta.com/insights/mcp-apps-tool-annotations/): MCP tools can now return interactive UIs, and annotations hint at tool risk. How MCP Apps and tool annotations work, what they can't guarantee, and how I govern them.
- [Saudi PDPL and cross-border AI: designing data flows that hold up](https://asksumanta.com/insights/saudi-pdpl-cross-border-ai/): Saudi Arabia's PDPL is enforceable and its transfer rules shape where AI can process data. SCCs, risk assessments, and the architecture I use for Saudi AI products.
- [Ambient AI scribes: what the evidence says, and how to deploy them safely](https://asksumanta.com/insights/ambient-ai-scribes-architecture/): Randomised trials of ambient AI scribes show modest time savings and real error rates. What the evidence says, and the architecture and review controls I'd put around them.
- [Apache Iceberg v3: what changes from v2, and when your lakehouse should upgrade](https://asksumanta.com/insights/apache-iceberg-v3-lakehouse/): Iceberg v3 adds deletion vectors, row lineage, variant and geospatial types. What changes from v2, the one-way upgrade risk, and how I decide when a data platform should move.
- [OpenTelemetry Profiles is in alpha: the fourth signal and what to do about it](https://asksumanta.com/insights/opentelemetry-profiles-alpha/): Continuous profiling joins traces, metrics and logs in OpenTelemetry. What the Profiles alpha includes, why it matters for cost and AI workloads, and how to pilot it safely.
- [DIFC Regulation 10: what it means for AI systems built in Dubai's financial centre](https://asksumanta.com/insights/difc-regulation-10-ai-systems/): DIFC Regulation 10 governs personal data processed by autonomous and semi-autonomous systems. What it requires, what's still pending, and how I design AI systems to meet it.
- [DGX Spark as an AI architect's bench: what it is good for, and what it isn't](https://asksumanta.com/insights/dgx-spark-ai-architect-bench/): 128 GB of unified memory on a desk changes how I prototype private AI. What NVIDIA DGX Spark does well, where memory bandwidth limits it, and how I use it with clients.
- [SHACL for knowledge graphs: a practical validation checklist](https://asksumanta.com/insights/shacl-validation-knowledge-graphs/): OWL tells you what can be inferred; SHACL tells you whether your data is acceptable. A practical checklist for using SHACL shapes to keep enterprise knowledge graphs clean.
- [Ingress NGINX is retired: a practical playbook for moving to Gateway API](https://asksumanta.com/insights/ingress-nginx-to-gateway-api/): The community Ingress NGINX controller stopped receiving fixes in March 2026. A practical playbook for inventorying annotations and moving to Kubernetes Gateway API safely.
- [DORA metrics in the AI era: what engineering leaders should actually measure](https://asksumanta.com/insights/dora-metrics-ai-assisted-engineering/): DORA's 2025 research found AI amplifies what teams already are. What changed in the metrics, why rework rate matters, and how I set up delivery measurement as a CTO.
- [FHIR Bulk Data export: building population data pipelines that survive production](https://asksumanta.com/insights/fhir-bulk-data-export-pipelines/): FHIR Bulk Data $export moves population data out of EHRs as NDJSON. How the async flow works, where pipelines break, and how I design for incremental loads.
- [Multi-tenant SaaS on MongoDB: choosing the right level of isolation](https://asksumanta.com/insights/mongodb-multi-tenant-saas-patterns/): Shared collection, database per tenant or cluster per tenant? How I choose MongoDB multi-tenancy patterns for SaaS and AI products, including search and vector indexes.
- [Prompt injection and AI agents: stop trying to block it, design to contain it](https://asksumanta.com/insights/prompt-injection-defence-for-agents/): Prompt injection can't be fully prevented, says the NCSC. How I design agents to contain it: the lethal trifecta, privileged and quarantined models, and hard boundaries.
- [The proposed HIPAA Security Rule overhaul: what healthcare AI teams should build now](https://asksumanta.com/insights/hipaa-security-rule-proposal-ai-platforms/): HHS proposed a major HIPAA Security Rule overhaul in 2025: encryption, MFA, asset inventories. It isn't final, but here is what healthcare AI teams should build now.
- [GraphRAG vs vector RAG: when a knowledge graph is worth the cost](https://asksumanta.com/insights/graphrag-when-it-beats-vector-rag/): GraphRAG answers whole-corpus questions plain RAG can't, at a real indexing cost. When it's worth building, how it works, and how I'd combine it with an ontology.
- [Build vs buy for AI: a decision framework for leadership teams](https://asksumanta.com/insights/build-vs-buy-ai-capabilities/): Should you build AI capabilities or buy them? A practical framework for CTOs and boards: what to own, what to rent, and the questions that decide each case.
- [GPUs on Kubernetes: what Dynamic Resource Allocation changes for AI platforms](https://asksumanta.com/insights/kubernetes-dra-gpu-scheduling/): Kubernetes Dynamic Resource Allocation replaces 'give me one GPU' with real device requests: fallbacks, partitions and taints. What changed in 1.36 and 1.37, and how to adopt it.
- [Change data capture: turning your database into a reliable event stream](https://asksumanta.com/insights/change-data-capture-event-streams/): Change data capture streams every insert, update and delete as events. How I use Debezium, MongoDB change streams and Postgres logical decoding, and the pitfalls.
- [Building AI in the UAE: where should your models actually run?](https://asksumanta.com/insights/uae-ai-infrastructure-where-to-run-models/): In-country cloud regions, Stargate UAE and data protection rules change where UAE AI workloads should run. A practical framework for choosing hosting by data sensitivity.
- [Multi-cloud Terraform: what to abstract, and what to leave alone](https://asksumanta.com/insights/terraform-multi-cloud-module-design/): Multi-cloud Terraform fails when teams abstract too much. How I compose small modules across AWS, Azure and GCP, and where OpenTofu fits after the licence change.
- [FDA change control plans for AI medical devices: what engineering teams need to build](https://asksumanta.com/insights/fda-pccp-ai-medical-devices/): The FDA's PCCP guidance lets AI-enabled medical devices change within pre-agreed limits. What it means for ML engineering, data pipelines and MLOps on the device team.
- [Entity resolution for knowledge graphs: block, match, cluster](https://asksumanta.com/insights/entity-resolution-knowledge-graphs/): A knowledge graph is only as good as its entities. How I resolve duplicate customers, patients and products with blocking, probabilistic matching and clustering.
- [SOC 2 for AI and SaaS startups: an engineering-first plan](https://asksumanta.com/insights/soc2-for-ai-startups/): Enterprise buyers ask for SOC 2 early. What Type 1 and Type 2 mean, which Trust Services Criteria to pick, and how to build controls into the platform, not a binder.
- [Building LLM evaluation sets that actually predict production](https://asksumanta.com/insights/llm-evaluation-sets-that-predict-production/): Most LLM evals pass in testing and miss real failures. A checklist for building evaluation sets, using LLM judges carefully and gating releases on evidence.
- [OMOP data quality in practice: conformance, completeness and plausibility](https://asksumanta.com/insights/omop-data-quality-checks/): Converting to OMOP is half the job; trusting the data is the other half. How I use the Kahn framework, ACHILLES, the Data Quality Dashboard and ETL unit tests.
- [Architecture decision records: the habit I bring to every engagement](https://asksumanta.com/insights/architecture-decision-records-fractional-cto/): Architecture decision records turn tribal knowledge into a searchable history. How I use ADRs as a fractional CTO to speed up decisions and hand over cleanly.
- [LLM observability with OpenTelemetry: what to trace, what to leave out, and why it matters](https://asksumanta.com/insights/llm-observability-opentelemetry-genai/): OpenTelemetry's GenAI conventions give a standard way to trace LLM calls, tokens and tool use. What to capture, what to keep out, and how I set it up.
- [Idempotency for payments and orders: how to never charge a customer twice](https://asksumanta.com/insights/idempotent-payments-order-pipelines/): Retries are inevitable, double charges are not. How I design idempotent payment and order pipelines with idempotency keys, the outbox pattern and safe consumers.
- [Kubernetes FinOps in 2026: scale to zero, resize in place, and know who pays](https://asksumanta.com/insights/kubernetes-finops-scale-to-zero/): Kubernetes 1.36 and 1.37 added in-place pod resize and HPA scale-to-zero. - [Hybrid search for RAG in MongoDB: when to use $rankFusion, and when $scoreFusion](https://asksumanta.com/insights/mongodb-hybrid-search-rag/): Vector search alone misses exact terms. How I use MongoDB's $rankFusion and $scoreFusion to combine vector and full-text retrieval for RAG, and how to tune them.
- [UAE PDPL and AI in 2026: designing for a law whose detailed rules aren't written yet](https://asksumanta.com/insights/uae-pdpl-ai-architecture-2026/): The UAE PDPL is in force but key executive regulations are reportedly still unpublished. - [The EU AI Act after the Digital Omnibus: what actually changes for your AI roadmap](https://asksumanta.com/insights/eu-ai-act-digital-omnibus-roadmap/): The Digital Omnibus pushed EU AI Act high-risk deadlines to December 2027 and August 2028. - [Ontology vs knowledge graph vs semantic layer: what's the difference, and which do you need?](https://asksumanta.com/insights/ontology-vs-knowledge-graph-vs-semantic-layer/): Clear definitions of ontologies, knowledge graphs and semantic layers, how they fit together, when to use each, and how they make LLMs and RAG more accurate.
